entries.20bb30ae11455458: As its management policy, the company cites 'Clean & Safety' as its watchword and aims to make products society needs, through developing products and technologies and improving materials that take the natural and working environment into account, and its envisioned corporate image is an 'all-weather global company'. For the fiscal year ending February 2027, the management challenges are stated as 'promoting environmental management and improvement activities, and maximizing customer satisfaction with safety first', and the key issues include strengthening sales of in-house developed products in food-related business, its core division, and responding quickly to customer needs, as well as strengthening technological and development capabilities in IT and industrial materials-related business.
entries.282c6272113404f0: The company, together with 14 consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate, forms the group and manufactures and sells products using gravure printing, coating, lamination and molding processes.
